item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns over affair allegations
item.body: The billionaire tech executive has left the company following reports of a second extramarital affair.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 📱 Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns over affair allegations
